## Code Review

This pull request adds support for retrying transactions when they fail due to an expired transaction ID, which Firestore reports as an `InvalidArgument` exception. This is implemented by introducing a helper function `_is_retryable_commit_error` that checks for `Aborted` exceptions or `InvalidArgument` exceptions containing the substring 'transaction has expired', and integrating this check into both synchronous and asynchronous transaction commit loops. Comprehensive unit tests are also added. The review feedback recommends making the substring check case-insensitive to ensure robustness against potential casing variations in the backend error message.
